new_texts: There are many additional tools available that allow you to expand your understanding of The Bibites or add a few functionalities that are not yet present in-game. Here, I'll try to link you to a few of those.

The wiki is a treasure trove of information regarding the inner workings of the simulation and will allow you to get a far deeper understanding of the mechanics at play. It's by no means complete; I basically just added the first basic information myself, and I expect the community to take the ball and maintain, deepen, and bolster it.

This is a link to the Bibite Research Conglomerate, an un-official Discord server that is centered around exploring The Bibites under all its facets. 
This is 100% a public fan-made and fan-maintained server, and the devs are not there themselves, but we mentioned it in a couple videos and people keep asking for the link

So if you want to interact with an awesome community of moders, researchers, and share your discoveries and creations, I'm sure they'll welcome you with open arms!

And again, of course, I want to reiterate my eternal gratitude toward my patrons who are supporting the project on Patreon. You allow me to keep working on the project full-time, and I'll be forever grateful for this reason alone.

As the bibites have procedural appearances, allowing the bibites to adopt a wide variety of appearances depending on their genes, and as I often have to show an image of a particular bibite in my videos, I developed a custom sprite editor that allows you to export an image of a bibite defined by a set of genes. I might as well make it available to users!
